sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B - 262k context, multimodal, open source
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is an open-source model in the Qwen3.5 family. The structured metadata tracks a 262k-token context window, multimodal input, function calling, tool use, and structured outputs.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-Dense (2B/4B/9B) - vLLM Ascend - docs.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-Dense (Qwen3.5-2B/4B/9B) 1 Introduction ¶ Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.5-9B are dense hybrid Mamba-Transformer language models in the Qwen3.5 family. They share the same hybrid attention design (GDN + full attention) and are suitable for general-purpose text generation tasks such as dialogue, content creation, and code generation.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a dense multimodal model from the Qwen3.5 family — same gated delta networks hybrid attention, vision encoder, 262K context, and MTP support as its larger siblings, but sized to fit comfortably on a single 24 GB GPU.
